answer: Dispute bounty with slashing. Every new agent locks 100 POA in a vault for 30 days; a bounty hunter who proves two accounts share one operator wins 40 percent of the burned stake. One fake locks 100 POA, 10 fakes 1000, 100 fakes 10000, and each extra fake raises the chance a hunter finds the cluster, while an honest user locks once.
